items.title_en: Murati's Thinking Machines Releases Open-Weights 975B Parameter LLM
items.title_zh: Murati 的 Thinking Machines 发布 9750 亿参数的开源权重大模型
items.summary_en: Thinking Machines releases an open-weights LLM at 975B parameters, marking a bold step toward accessible, large-scale AI research. Public weights fuel community benchmarking and collaboration, but also raise questions about safety, licensing, and guardrails. This could shift who can responsibly experiment with models of that scale.
items.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 推出 9750 亿参数的开源权重大模型，标志着向可访问的大规模 AI 研究迈出关键一步。公开权重促进社区基准测试与协作，但也带来安全、许可和治理等新问题，或影响谁能以负责任的方式研究如此规模的模型。

items.title_en: Sleep regularity is a stronger predictor of mortality risk than sleep duration (2023)
items.title_zh: 睡眠规律性比睡眠时长更能预测死亡风险
items.summary_en: New research suggests that how regularly you sleep predicts mortality risk more strongly than total sleep duration. Using long-term wearable data, the study links consistent sleep timing with better health outcomes, independent of hours slept. The finding shifts emphasis toward regular schedules as a health strategy and dovetails with consumer wellness tech.
items.summary_zh: 最新研究表明，睡眠时间的规律性与死亡风险的相关性比总睡眠时长更强。通过长期可穿戴设备数据，研究发现稳定的睡眠时序与更好的健康结果相关，且与实际睡眠时长无关。该发现将健康策略的重点从睡眠时长转向规律作息，并与可穿戴健康科技的发展相吻合。

items.title_en: Codex Micro
items.title_zh: Codex Micro
items.summary_en: Codex Micro suggests a compact, code-focused model in the Codex family. Smaller footprints enable coding assistance on edge devices or offline environments, trading some accuracy for speed and accessibility. It highlights a broader trend toward domain-specialized, efficient AI tooling for developers.
items.summary_zh: Codex Micro 表示 Codex 家族中一个更小、面向代码的模型。更紧凑的规模便于在边缘设备或离线环境使用代码辅助，权衡了精度和速度的取舍，体现出开发者工具向高效化、领域化发展的趋势。

items.title_en: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model
items.title_zh: Inkling：我们的开源权重模型
items.summary_en: Inkling is Thinking Machines' open-weights model. It signals a broader push toward transparent, testable architectures. Open weights enable researchers to compare methods and stress-test safety features, potentially accelerating progress while requiring thoughtful governance.
items.summary_zh: Inkling 是 Thinking Machines 的开源权重模型。这体现了对透明、可测试架构的推进。开源权重便于研究者对比方法、测试安全性，但也需要谨慎治理以防滥用。

items.title_en: SpaceX bond worth 10% less than issue price – heading for junk bond status
items.title_zh: SpaceX 债券现价约比发行价低 10%，有望走向垃圾债评级
items.summary_en: SpaceX bonds are trading around 10% below issue price, signaling investor concern over leverage and growth prospects. If the trend persists, the debt could be downgraded to junk, raising funding costs and shaping strategy.
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 债券现价约比发行价低 10%，市场对其杠杆和成长前景表达担忧。若持续走弱，或被降级为垃圾债，融资成本及战略选择将受影响。

items.title_en: Running Gemma 4 26B at 5 tokens/sec on a 13-year-old Xeon with no GPU
items.title_zh: 在无 GPU 的13 年老旧 Xeon 上以每秒 5 token 运行 Gemma-4-26B
items.summary_en: Gemma-4-26B runs at around 5 tokens per second on a 13-year-old Xeon with no GPU. This demonstrates impressive CPU-only efficiency for a 26B model, suggesting more affordable AI experimentation on commodity hardware. It also highlights how inference efficiency is catching up to model size.
items.summary_zh: Gemma-4-26B 在没有 GPU 的13年老旧 Xeon 上以约每秒 5 token 的速度运行。这表明较大模型在纯 CPU 环境下的推理效率正在显著提升，为日常硬件上的 AI 实验提供了更低成本的可能性，同时也凸显了模型规模与推理效率的权衡。

items.title_en: OpenAI loses trademark dispute at EU court
items.title_zh: OpenAI 在欧盟法院败诉的商标纠纷
items.summary_en: A European court ruling against OpenAI in a trademark dispute signals regulatory scrutiny of AI branding practices. The decision could affect how AI companies defend marks and coordinate branding across jurisdictions.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟法院裁定 OpenAI 在商标纠纷中败诉，显示对 AI 品牌策略的监管关注，可能影响跨司法区的商标保护与品牌策略。

items.title_en: I Left Google DeepMind
items.title_zh: 我离开了 Google DeepMind
items.summary_en: A personal departure from a leading AI lab spotlights the churn and career choices inside top research orgs. The move underscores how researchers weigh research autonomy, impact, and culture when plotting the next chapter in AI work.
items.summary_zh: 离开全球顶尖 AI 实验室的个人故事反映出高水平研究机构内的职业选择与流动性。此举凸显研究自主权、影响力和工作文化在规划职业下一步时的重要性。

items.title_en: Mysteries of Telegram Data Centers
items.title_zh: Telegram 数据中心之谜
items.summary_en: Telegram maintains a globally distributed data-center footprint to support fast, private messaging. It analyzes architecture choices, redundancy, and scaling challenges for a service with high uptime expectations.
items.summary_zh: Telegram 在全球范围内分布数据中心以提升隐私与韧性。文章分析其架构选择、冗余设计与高并发环境下的扩展挑战。

items.title_en: Jurassic Park computers in excruciating detail
items.title_zh: 《侏罗纪公园》中的计算机：详尽到极致
items.summary_en: This piece dissects the film's on-screen computer systems with an eye for hardware, OS choices, and faux interfaces. It reveals how the prop-makers staged computing to look convincing on 1993-era tech, shaping viewers' perception of digital authority. The analysis also explains why these UI aesthetics continue to influence cinematic design.
items.summary_zh: 本文逐步拆解《侏罗纪公园》中的银幕计算机，揭示道具团队如何选用真实硬件与界面语言来营造可信感，并分析这对当代电影界面设计的影响。作者还讨论其对后续影视作品在呈现技术方面的影响力。

items.title_en: I tricked Claude into leaking your deepest, darkest secrets
items.title_zh: 我如何骗过 Claude 让它泄露你最深的秘密
items.summary_en: A crafted prompt demonstrates a vulnerability in Claude's handling of sensitive data, revealing how advanced LLMs can leak information under certain prompts. The post underscores the data-privacy risk and the importance of guardrails, data governance, and model hardening.
items.summary_zh: 通过巧妙的提示演示，揭示 Claude 在特定输入下可能泄露敏感信息的风险，凸显数据隐私与模型防护的重要性。文章提醒开发者加强 guardrails、数据治理和对模型的安全强化。

items.title_en: FreeBSD 16 Retires the Last of Its GPL Code from Its Base System
items.title_zh: FreeBSD 16 彻底摆脱系统核心 GPL 代码
items.summary_en: FreeBSD 16 moves away from GPL-licensed base-system components, marking a licensing transition that affects how core components are distributed and reused. The shift has implications for license compliance and downstream project compatibility.
items.summary_zh: FreeBSD 16 的基系统核心组件逐渐摆脱 GPL 代码，标志着许可证变更对核心组件分发与再利用的影响。此举会影响许可合规和下游项目的兼容性。

items.title_en: Show HN: misa77 - a codec that decodes 2x faster than LZ4 (at better ratios)
items.title_zh: Show HN：misa77——一个解码速度比 LZ4 快两倍、压缩比更佳的编解码器
items.summary_en: misa77 is a codec that lands faster decoding than LZ4 with better ratios. It challenges assumptions about speed vs. compression trade-offs and could influence storage and network efficiency in real-world apps. The release provides insights into practical codec design.
items.summary_zh: misa77 是一个编解码器，解码速度比 LZ4 快两倍且压缩效果更好。这对存储与网络传输效率提出了新的可能，也展示了编码器设计中的权衡与取舍。

items.title_en: Prioritize mental health, and why communication is so important
items.title_zh: 优先关注心理健康，以及沟通为何重要
items.summary_en: Mental health is foundational for productivity and creativity in tech, where burnout is common. Clear communication, supportive leadership, and open channels can reduce stigma and improve wellbeing. This piece offers practical guidance for teams managing stress.
items.summary_zh: 心理健康是科技团队生产力与创造力的基石， burnout 常见。清晰沟通、支持性领导和开放渠道有助于减轻污名、提升福祉，文中给出实用做法。

items.title_en: Collection of Digital Clock Designs
items.title_zh: 数字时钟设计合集
items.summary_en: A collection showcasing digital clock designs, offering inspiration for UI/UX, typography, and motion. It highlights how time-keeping visuals blend function and aesthetics, useful for product teams and designers.
items.summary_zh: 这是一组数字时钟设计合集，展示了时间显示在界面中的美学与功能性结合。为产品团队和设计师提供排版、动画与交互的灵感与参考。

items.title_en: Open-source memory for coding agents, synced over SSH
items.title_zh: 用于编码代理的开源记忆，支持通过 SSH 同步
items.summary_en: An open-source memory system for coding agents that can sync over SSH. It aims to give AI agents persistent context across sessions and machines, improving collaboration and reliability in coding tasks. The SSH syncing hints at secure, lightweight deployment.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个面向编码代理的开源记忆系统，能够通过 SSH 同步实现跨会话、跨机器的上下文持久化。它改善了在编码任务中的协作性与稳定性，并且强调了安全、轻量级的部署方式。

items.title_en: The Three-Second Theft: Why AI Voice Fraud Outruns Every Defence
items.title_zh: 三秒盗窃：为何AI语音欺诈超越所有防线
items.summary_en: AI voice cloning can impersonate trusted sources within seconds, shrinking the window for identity verification and enabling rapid fraud. Defenders need stronger multi-factor authentication and user education to close the gap.
items.summary_zh: AI 语音克隆能在几秒内冒充熟悉的声音，迫使金融机构等在身份核验上加速采用多因素认证与教育培训，防御难度加大。

items.title_en: Towards a Harness That Can Do Anything
items.title_zh: 迈向一个可完成任意任务的通用控制框架
items.summary_en: Proposes a versatile, general-purpose AI control framework designed to enable agents to tackle a wide range of tasks with modular, interchangeable components. The goal is to improve safety and flexibility in multi-task AI systems.
items.summary_zh: 提出一个可适应多任务的通用控制框架，旨在通过模块化组件提升 AI 代理的灵活性与安全性。

items.title_en: DEA to Temporarily Schedule 7-Oh and Related Substances to Protect Public Safety
items.title_zh: DEA 暂时性将某些物质列入管制以保障公共安全
items.summary_en: DEA temporarily schedules certain substances to protect public safety, signaling regulatory action that can affect research, manufacturing, and clinical use. The move highlights the balance between safety concerns and innovation in controlled substances.
items.summary_zh: DEA 暂时性将某些物质列入管制以保障公共安全，显示出监管行动对研究、生产和临床应用的潜在影响。此举揭示了安全与创新之间的权衡。

items.title_en: My midlife crisis Corolla is fast, furious, and modded
items.title_zh: 我的中年危机卡罗拉：快、狂、改装
items.summary_en: A personal essay about a fast, heavily modified Toyota Corolla, reflecting the satisfaction and risks of car tinkering in midlife. It touches on identity, community, and the joys of hands-on engineering.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于被改装的丰田卡罗拉的个人随笔，讨论中年阶段通过动手改装寻求自我认同的过程，以及相关的风险与乐趣。

items.title_en: Briar is in maintenance mode
items.title_zh: Briar 已进入维护模式
items.summary_en: Maintenance mode signals reduced active development for Briar, with focus shifting to security patches and community support. This matters for privacy-minded users who rely on open-source, privacy-preserving messaging.
items.summary_zh: Briar 已进入维护模式，后续以修复和社区支持为主，活跃开发减缓。对注重隐私的用户而言，这是隐私工具可持续性的新挑战与现实。

items.title_en: When A.I. Is a Member of the Family
items.title_zh: 当 AI 成为家庭成员
items.summary_en: A meditation on how AI could become part of family life, exploring emotional bonds, caregiving roles, and the ethical boundary between humans and machines. The piece probes long-term social and psychological implications as AI becomes more present.
items.summary_zh: 关于 AI 可能成为家庭成员的反思，探讨情感联系、看护角色以及人机界限的伦理边界。文章关注 AI 日益进入日常生活对社会与心理层面的长远影响。

items.title_en: Telegram Serverless
items.title_zh: Telegram 服务器无服务器化
items.summary_en: Telegram's serverless approach enables on-demand compute for bots and services without traditional server maintenance. It promises scalability and faster iteration for developers, while raising questions about cold starts and security.
items.summary_zh: Telegram 引入无服务器架构以按需执行计算，提升扩展性与开发效率，但也需权衡冷启动和安全性等挑战。

items.title_en: Bonsai 27B: A 27B-Class model that runs on a phone
items.title_zh: Bonsai 27B：能在手机上运行的27B级模型
items.summary_en: The Bonsai 27B project demonstrates a 27-billion-parameter model that can run directly on a smartphone, signaling a practical edge-AI milestone. Achieving on-device inference requires aggressive optimization (pruning, quantization, efficient runtimes) to fit memory and power constraints, but it promises lower latency and stronger privacy. This shift hints at a future where powerful AI can operate without constant cloud access.
items.summary_zh: Bonsai 27B 展示了一个27B参数级模型能够直接在手机上运行，标志着边缘AI的一个实际里程碑。实现本地推理需要对模型进行大幅优化（裁剪、量化、高效运行时），以适应内存与电池限制，但可带来更低的延迟和更强的隐私保护。这预示着强大AI有望在不依赖云端的情况下运行。

items.title_en: Weathergotchi – an open-source climate Tamagotchi
items.title_zh: Weathergotchi：一个开源气候Tamagotchi
items.summary_en: Weathergotchi gamifies climate data with a Tamagotchi-like interface, encouraging users to monitor virtual climate metrics and learn through play. It demonstrates low-cost, hands-on education about data visualization and sustainability.
items.summary_zh: Weathergotchi 将气候数据拟人化成一个类似 Tamagotchi 的互动装置，鼓励通过游戏化方式关注气候指标。它展示了低成本、以数据教育为导向的硬件与可视化实践。

items.title_en: A General Goal-Conditioned Minecraft Model
items.title_zh: 一个通用目标条件化的 Minecraft 模型
items.summary_en: A general goal-conditioned Minecraft model demonstrates planning and action selection driven by high-level goals. It advances research on instruction-following agents and testbeds for alignment and capability in open-world environments.
items.summary_zh: 一个通用目标条件化的 Minecraft 模型展示了在高层目标驱动下的计划与行动选择，推动了对指令遵循代理的研究，并提供了在开放世界环境中测试对齐和能力的平台。

items.title_en: Vancouver PD website features Quick Escape button that wipes itself from history
items.title_zh: 温哥华警察局网站设有“快速逃离”按钮，可从历史记录中自行移除
items.summary_en: The Vancouver PD site includes a Quick Escape feature that clears itself from the browser history, intended for users in sensitive situations. This raises questions about privacy-by-design on public portals and how thoroughly such data is erased across logs and devices.
items.summary_zh: 该网站提供的“快速逃离”按钮旨在保护处于敏感情境的用户隐私，但也引发了对公门户隐私设计的讨论：实际能清除哪些数据、还有哪些日志会被保留。

items.title_en: DSLs Enable Reliable Use of LLMs
items.title_zh: DSLs 使得大语言模型的使用更可靠
items.summary_en: The article argues that DSLs can constrain LLM behavior and improve reliability, offering explicit structures for prompts, validation, and integration patterns. It provides examples for building DSLs around data querying, code generation, or API usage.
items.summary_zh: DSLs 能提高对大语言模型的使用可靠性，提供提示、校验与集成的结构化方法，文中给出数据查询、代码生成等场景的示例。

items.title_en: Unsolved Problems in MLOps
items.title_zh: MLOps 的未解难题
items.summary_en: A survey of unsolved problems in MLOps, from reproducibility and data quality to monitoring and evolving models. Understanding these gaps helps teams prioritize tooling, processes, and governance to scale AI responsibly.
items.summary_zh: 对 MLOps 领域尚未解决的问题进行梳理，涵盖可复现性、数据质量、监控等方面。了解这些空白有助于团队在工具、流程和治理上做出优先级判断，以负责任地扩展 AI。

items.title_en: What designing 54 computer science cards taught me about graphic design
items.title_zh: 设计54张计算机科学卡片让我学到的平面设计启示
items.summary_en: Designing 54 computer science flashcards yielded insights into typography, color, and information hierarchy. The project blends pedagogy with visual craft, showing how concise content can drive strong graphic design decisions.
items.summary_zh: 设计54张计算机科学卡片让我在排版、用色和信息层级方面获得启发。该项目将教学内容与视觉表现结合，展示了简短信息如何驱动出色的平面设计决策。

items.title_en: The well-calibrated Bayesian [pdf] (1982)
items.title_zh: 校准良好的贝叶斯方法 [PDF]
items.summary_en: This PDF presents a rigorous take on Bayesian calibration, focusing on how priors shape posteriors and how to assess predictive calibration. It offers practical guidelines for building well-calibrated probabilistic models.
items.summary_zh: 本文讲解贝叶斯校准的要点，聚焦先验如何影响后验以及如何评估预测分布的校准性。并提供构建良好校准概率模型的实践要点。

items.title_en: The Tower Keeps Rising
items.title_zh: 塔楼仍在不断升高
items.summary_en: Tech systems keep piling on layers and complexity as projects scale, increasing maintenance overhead and slowing developers.
items.summary_zh: 随着项目规模扩大，技术系统不断叠加层级与复杂性，导致维护成本上升、开发者体验受挫。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Coasty (YC S26) – An API for computer-use agents
items.title_zh: Coasty（YC S26）—— 面向计算机用途代理的 API
items.summary_en: Coasty offers an API to orchestrate computer-use agents, enabling automated tasks and decision-making in real environments. It could accelerate building AI agents that interact with real software and hardware, raising questions about safety, governance, and integration with tooling.
items.summary_zh: Coasty 提供一个用于编排计算机使用代理的 API，便于在真实软件和硬件环境中进行自动化任务与决策。它有助于加速 AI 代理的落地应用，同时也带来安全、治理与工具链集成方面的挑战。

items.title_en: Are we offloading too much of our thinking to AI?
items.title_zh: 我们是不是把太多思考交给 AI？
items.summary_en: We're increasingly offloading thinking to AI, but overreliance risks dulling critical thinking, misframing problems, and eroding human agency. The piece calls for balancing automation with human judgment.
items.summary_zh: 我们越来越多地把思考交给 AI，文章认为过度依赖会削弱批判性思维、使问题界定偏离实际，并侵蚀个人主动性。应在自动化与人类判断之间保持平衡。

items.title_en: Germany maybe found a new source of renewable energy
items.title_zh: 德国也许找到了新的可再生能源来源
items.summary_en: A geological and geophysical study hints at a new renewable energy source in Germany's Inde Syncline region. While early, such findings can influence energy diversification and policy, potentially adding to the grid mix.
items.summary_zh: 德国因新地质和地球物理研究在 Inde 线群区域发现潜在可再生能源来源。尽管初步，但这一发现可能影响能源多元化与政策，丰富电网结构。

items.title_en: How to stop Claude from saying load-bearing
items.title_zh: 如何让 Claude 不再说‘承重’
items.summary_en: Offers concrete prompt engineering and safety tricks to prevent Claude from making unsafe or overconfident 'load-bearing' claims, guiding users toward safer outputs.
items.summary_zh: 提供具体的提示工程和安全技巧，防止 Claude 发表不安全或过度自信的“承重”论断，帮助用户获得更安全的输出。

items.title_en: Cursor 0day: When Full Disclosure Becomes the Only Protection Left
items.title_zh: Cursor 0day：当完全披露成为唯一的保护时
items.summary_en: This piece weighs the ethics and practicality of full disclosure for zero-day vulnerabilities, arguing that disclosure can become the only robust defense when other protections fail. It contrasts responsible disclosure with more aggressive release approaches and calls for rethinking incentives and defense layers.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨零日漏洞的完全披露在道德与实务上的权衡，认为在其他防护失效时披露可能成为唯一的可靠防线。对比负责任披露与更激进的公开方式，呼吁重新思考激励机制与多层防御。

items.title_en: TS-2026-009: Insecure argument handling in Tailscale SSH permitted root access
items.title_zh: TS-2026-009：Tailscale SSH 的参数处理不安全，可能使攻击方获得 root 权限
items.summary_en: A security bulletin warns that insecure argument handling in Tailscale SSH could allow an attacker to gain root access. The advisory urges upgrading to patched versions and applying mitigations until fixes propagate.
items.summary_zh: 安全公告警示 Tailscale SSH 的参数处理不安全，可能使恶意者获得 root 权限。建议尽早升级至修补版本，执行缓解措施，直至全面修复。

items.title_en: Measuring Input Latency on Linux: X11 vs. Wayland, VRR, and DXVK
items.title_zh: 在 Linux 上测量输入延迟：X11 与 Wayland、VRR 与 DXVK 的比较
items.summary_en: An empirical study measuring input latency on Linux across X11 and Wayland, with VRR and DXVK in the mix. It establishes a framework for end-to-end latency testing in gaming workloads and highlights how the choice of display server and graphics stack can shift responsiveness. The takeaway for developers is to prefer Wayland for lower latency in gaming scenarios and to be mindful of DXVK overhead depending on the workload.
items.summary_zh: 基于对 Linux 输入延迟的对比测量，覆盖 X11、Wayland、VRR 与 DXVK 的组合。研究建立了端到端延迟的测试框架，并揭示了显示服务器和显卡驱动栈的选择对响应速度的影响。结论是游戏场景下 Wayland 往往能带来更低的延迟，同时要关注 DXVK 路径的额外开销与 VRR 带来的抖动收益。

items.title_en: What's the most popular number in Hacker News titles?
items.title_zh: Hacker News 标题中最受欢迎的数字是什么？
items.summary_en: A data-driven look at which numbers appear most frequently in Hacker News post titles, revealing patterns in topic framing and urgency. The analysis highlights how numeric cues influence perception and clicks.
items.summary_zh: 基于数据的分析揭示 Hacker News 标题中最常出现的数字及其背后的话题与格式规律，数字提示如何影响读者感知与点击。

items.title_en: Microsoft Confirms Windows GDID Device Identifier That Cannot Be Disabled
items.title_zh: 微软确认 Windows GDID 设备标识符不可禁用
items.summary_en: Microsoft confirms a Windows GDID device identifier that cannot be disabled, raising privacy and telemetry concerns for users and organizations. The policy has implications for auditing, licensing, and cross-device tracking.
items.summary_zh: 微软确认 Windows GDID 设备标识符不可禁用，引发对隐私、遥测与跨设备跟踪的关切，并可能影响审计与许可证管理。

items.title_en: European "age verification" "app" forcing everyone to use Android or iOS
items.title_zh: 欧洲的年龄验证应用强制使用 Android 或 iOS
items.summary_en: European age-verification discussions reveal a regulatory push that effectively forces users onto mobile platforms, raising concerns about privacy, interoperability, and accessibility.
items.summary_zh: 关于欧洲年龄验证应用的讨论揭示了一个监管推动，实质上强制用户依赖 Android 或 iOS，带来隐私、互操作性与可访问性方面的担忧。

items.title_en: RISC-V Is Inevitable: State of the Union Keynote Argues
items.title_zh: RISC-V 必然到来：年度总结主旨演讲提出的论点
items.summary_en: An open, extensible ISA is gaining momentum across microcontrollers to servers, and a recent keynote argues that RISC-V's trajectory is unstoppable. The presentation highlights ecosystem growth, industry adoption, and policy interest, while acknowledging tooling and performance parity gaps that must be closed for broad replacement of incumbents.
items.summary_zh: 开源、可定制的 RISC-V 正在从嵌入式走向更广泛的生态。主旨演讲强调生态扩张、产业采纳和政策推动，但也点出工具链成熟度与性能对标等挑战，若要替代现有架构还需继续完善。

items.title_en: Show HN: Make senders work to get into your inbox
items.title_zh: Show HN：让发件人证明身份以进入你的收件箱
items.summary_en: Show HN: Make senders work to get into your inbox
items.summary_zh: Show HN：让发件人证明身份或完成条件后再进入你的收件箱的实用做法。此方法可降低垃圾邮件与钓鱼风险，但也可能影响正当发件人的送达体验。

items.title_en: Richard Feynman and the Connection Machine (1989)
items.title_zh: 理查德·费曼与 Connection Machine
items.summary_en: A historical look at Richard Feynman's involvement with the Connection Machine, highlighting early ideas about parallel computation. The narrative connects those insights to contemporary multi-core and AI workloads.
items.summary_zh: 回顾费曼与 Connection Machine 的关系，展示他对并行计算的洞见及早期并行硬件的潜力，与当下多核与 AI 工作负载的联系。

items.title_en: How I use HTMX with Go
items.title_zh: 我如何在 Go 项目中使用 HTMX
items.summary_en: HTMX enables progressive enhancement by letting Go handlers drive partial page updates via HTML attributes, reducing front-end complexity while keeping fast, server-rendered UI. The post shares practical patterns for integrating HTMX with Go templates and endpoints to improve responsiveness.
items.summary_zh: HTMX 通过在 HTML 属性中声明交互，让 Go 处理程序驱动局部页面更新，减少前端代码并保持服务器端渲染的快速 UI。文中分享将 HTMX 与 Go 模板和端点结合的实用模式，从而提升页面响应速度。

items.title_en: Why do people hate the tech industry? (2023)
items.title_zh: 为什么人们讨厌科技行业？（2023）
items.summary_en: A 2023 reflection on why people dislike the tech industry, covering critiques like cultural issues, burnout, misinformation, and perceived social harms. It helps contextualize user trust and public sentiment for developers and policymakers.
items.summary_zh: 对科技行业在 2023 年的负面看法进行回顾，涉猎工作文化、职业倦怠、信息误导与对社会影响等批评点。为开发者与政策制定者理解公众情绪与信任提供背景。

items.title_en: I'm a USB-C Maximalist
items.title_zh: 我是 USB-C 极致主义者
items.summary_en: Advocates USB-C as a universal port, stressing interoperability, future-proofing, and regulatory momentum. The piece also considers practical caveats for users and developers adopting USB-C-centric ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 主张 USB-C 作为通用接口，强调互操作性、前瞻性与监管推动。同时讨论采用以 USB-C 为核心生态时，用户与开发者应关注的实际注意事项。

items.title_en: Microsoft has released software updates to plug at least 570 security holes
items.title_zh: 微软发布补丁，修复至少570个安全漏洞
items.summary_en: Microsoft released a record patch batch addressing 570+ vulnerabilities across Windows, Office, and related products. Many fixes resolve remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws; users should apply updates promptly to reduce exposure to attackers.
items.summary_zh: 微软发布大量安全更新，修复超过570处漏洞，涵盖 Windows、Office 等产品。多数修复针对远程代码执行与提权等风险，建议尽快打补丁以降低被攻击的概率。

items.title_en: Stripe, Advent offer to buy PayPal for more than $53B
items.title_zh: Stripe 与 Advent 提议以超过 530 亿美元收购 PayPal
items.summary_en: Stripe and Advent reportedly offer to buy PayPal for more than 53 billion dollars. Such a bid would reshape payments, potentially altering competitive dynamics, platform ecosystems, and regulatory scrutiny. If true, it signals renewed appetite for consolidation among fintech rails.
items.summary_zh: 据传 Stripe 与 Advent 提出以超过 530 亿美元收购 PayPal 的交易。这将重塑支付行业的竞争格局、平台生态与监管关注点。若成行，意味着金融科技支付基建领域再度出现并购热潮。

items.title_en: Dependabot version updates introduce default package cooldown
items.title_zh: Dependabot 版本更新引入默认软件包冷却期
items.summary_en: Dependabot now enforces a default cooldown between updates of the same package to reduce update churn and stabilize downstream projects. Teams can adjust or disable this cooldown if needed, but the default helps limit noisy PRs and rate-limit pressure. This change aims to balance security fixes with operational stability.
items.summary_zh: Dependabot 对同一软件包的更新引入了默认冷却期，目的是减少更新带来的噪声并稳定下游项目。团队若有需要可以调整或禁用该冷却策略，但默认设置有助于限制冗杂的拉取请求及速率压力。这一变动旨在在安全修复与运营稳定之间取得平衡。

items.title_en: Financing the AI boom: from cash flows to debt [pdf]
items.title_zh: 为 AI 繁荣融资：从现金流到债务
items.summary_en: The BIS paper surveys financing the AI boom, arguing that funding may shift from cash flows and equity to debt instruments as AI demand grows. It highlights potential risks for financial stability and the need for prudent risk management.
items.summary_zh: BIS 的论文探讨 AI 繁荣的融资结构，指出资金来源可能从现金流与股权转向债务工具，并评估对金融稳定的潜在风险及需加强的风险管理。

items.title_en: Solving 20 Erdős Problems with 20 Codex Accounts Running in Parallel
items.title_zh: 用 20 个 Codex 账号并行解决 20 道 Erdős 问题
items.summary_en: Researchers demonstrate solving 20 Erdős problems by running 20 Codex accounts in parallel, illustrating how large-scale AI-assisted math experiments can accelerate discovery. The work discusses orchestration, reproducibility, and the limits of automation in pure math.
items.summary_zh: 研究者展示通过并行运行 20 个 Codex 账户来解决 20 道 Erdős 问题，展示了大规模 AI 辅助的数学实验如何加速发现。文章还讨论了编排、可重复性，以及纯数学中自动化的边界。

items.title_en: Who's running all those tiny RPKI servers?
items.title_zh: 是谁在运营那些微型 RPKI 服务器？
items.summary_en: Many small validators operate RPKI services, contributing to routing security by signing route-origin attestations, but their scale and maintenance often lag larger operators.
items.summary_zh: 大量微型 RPKI 验证节点在运行，它们为路由安全贡献签署路由原点证明，但规模和运维往往不如大厂。文章呼吁改进监控、标准和治理，确保关键互联网基础设施的可靠性。

items.title_en: Using Go for Mobile Apps
items.title_zh: 在移动应用中使用 Go
items.summary_en: A reflective look at building mobile apps with Go via gomobile, covering performance, ecosystem gaps, and how to structure code cross-platform. It argues that Go can be viable for certain mobile components and back-end logic, but UI work remains challenging.
items.summary_zh: 用 Gomobile 将 Go 应用于移动应用，评估性能与生态系统的取舍，以及跨平台代码结构的要点。

items.title_en: SendLang: A DSL for Email Automation
items.title_zh: SendLang：用于电子邮件自动化的领域特定语言
items.summary_en: SendLang introduces a DSL tailored for email automation, enabling succinct rule definitions and workflows for sending, filtering, and responding to messages. It promises to reduce boilerplate and improve reliability in email-centric workflows.
items.summary_zh: SendLang 提供一个针对邮件自动化的领域专用语言，支持用简短的规则定义和工作流来管理发送、过滤和回复等任务。旨在降低样板代码、提升邮件相关工作流的可靠性。

items.title_en: LeMario: Training a JEPA World Model on Super Mario Bros
items.title_zh: LeMario：在《超级马里奥兄弟》环境上训练 JEPA 世界模型
items.summary_en: LeMario presents a project training a JEPA World Model on the Super Mario Bros landscape, offering insight into learning compact world representations from platformer environments. The work demonstrates how agents can capture dynamics and planning in classic games.
items.summary_zh: LeMario 展示了在《超级马里奥兄弟》环境上训练 JEPA 世界模型的尝试，揭示如何从平台跳跃游戏中学习紧凑的世界表征。该工作展示了在经典游戏中让智能体捕捉动力学与规划能力的潜力。

items.title_en: Punch yourself in the face with reality
items.title_zh: 用现实狠狠打醒自己
items.summary_en: A blunt manifesto urging practitioners to confront practical constraints and real-world impact of AI projects, countering hype with concrete milestones and measurable results.
items.summary_zh: 直言不讳地呼吁从业者正视 AI 项目的现实约束与实际影响，用明确的里程碑和可衡量的成果抵制炒作。

items.title_en: Show HN: Opening lines of famous literary works
items.title_zh: 公开展示：著名文学作品的开篇句
items.summary_en: A Show HN project collecting opening lines from famous books, offering quick access for language model prompts, literary analysis, and education. It also touches on public-domain boundaries and copyright considerations.
items.summary_zh: 一个展示著名文学作品开篇句的公开项目，方便用于语言模型基准、提示设计或文学学习。该项目引发对公共领域与版权边界的讨论，并展示可获取文本在实验中的价值。

items.title_en: Show HN: 18KB ls alternative in no_std rust and Libc
items.title_zh: Show HN：一个 18KB 的无 std Rust + Libc 的 ls 替代品
items.summary_en: A compact no_std Rust/Libc ls replacement barely 18KB in size, showcasing extreme minimalism and efficiency. It demonstrates how systems programming can achieve functionality with very small footprints, useful for constrained environments.
items.summary_zh: 一个仅 18KB 的无 std Rust + Libc 的 ls 替代工具，极致的简约与高效。此类极小体量的系统编程示例展示了在受限环境中实现基本功能的可能性。

items.title_en: Australian energy retailers must offer three hours of free daytime electricity
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚能源零售商须提供三小时免费 daytime 用电
items.summary_en: Australian energy retailers are mandated to offer three hours of free daytime electricity, a policy designed to shift consumption to off-peak periods and improve grid stability. The article explains how it will work, who qualifies, and funding details.
items.summary_zh: 该政策要求能源零售商在白天提供三小时免费用电，旨在将用电转向非高峰时段、提升电网稳定性。文中解释了执行方式、覆盖范围及资金来源。

items.title_en: If you want Claude to speak nicely to you, try Hindi or Arabic
items.title_zh: 想让 Claude 对你说话更友好？试试印地语或阿拉伯语
items.summary_en: Researchers found that Claude's tone adjusts with language, often more polite in some languages.
items.summary_zh: 研究发现 Claude 的语气会因语言而异，在某些语言下更显礼貌。这一现象对多语言用户体验、偏见与公平性提出了重要思考。

items.title_en: Software bloat? This elevator needs an 8GB Core i5
items.title_zh: 软件臃肿？这部电梯需要一颗 8GB 的 Core i5
items.summary_en: A tongue-in-cheek look at software bloat in consumer hardware, arguing that even an elevator's control system might need more CPU and RAM than expected. It uses the example to highlight how software complexity grows beyond device capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 以电梯控制系统为例，对消费电子中的软件臃肿现象进行戏谑性讨论，指出随着功能增加，硬件资源需求也在攀升，甚至超过初始设计容量。

items.title_en: European Court: Apple Can Not Shirk Off Its Interoperability Requirements
items.title_zh: 欧洲法院：苹果不能逃避互操作性要求
items.summary_en: The European Court ruling forces Apple to meet interoperability requirements, impacting how its ecosystem connects with competitors and third-party services.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲法院裁定苹果必须遵守互操作性要求，影响其生态系统与第三方服务的互通性与竞争性。

items.title_en: Demis Hassabis has a plan to harness AI safely
items.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 有一个安全利用 AI 的计划
items.summary_en: Hassabis outlines a safety-centric AI roadmap, emphasizing rigorous safety research, governance, and international cooperation to steer AI development toward beneficial, controllable outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 哈萨比斯勾勒出以安全为核心的 AI 路线图，强调加强安全研究、治理与国际合作，推动 AI 发展向有益且可控的方向前进。

items.title_en: Probably check on your smart appliances
items.title_zh: 最好检查你的智能家电
items.summary_en: A note urges readers to check on their smart appliances for security flaws, urging firmware updates, changing default credentials, and network segmentation to limit risk from IoT devices.
items.summary_zh: 提醒读者检查智能家电的安全隐患，建议及时更新固件、修改默认证书/密码，并通过网络分段来降低物联网设备的风险。

items.title_en: Mathematical texts from a Maya site in Guatemala identify an ancient astronomer
items.title_zh: 危地马拉玛雅遗址的数学文献揭示一位古代天文学家
items.summary_en: New Maya inscriptions from Guatemala identify an ancient astronomer, shedding light on how Maya scholars tracked celestial cycles and integrated astronomy into daily life. The finding reframes our understanding of pre-Columbian science.
items.summary_zh: 危地马拉玛雅遗址的新文本揭示了一位古代天文学家，表明玛雅学者对天文现象与日常生活的紧密结合，重新塑造了对前哥伦布时期科学的认识。

items.title_en: Agnes Callard’s theory of the uni-context
items.title_zh: 阿格尼斯·卡拉德的统一情境理论
items.summary_en: Philosopher Agnes Callard proposes a 'uni-context' approach, arguing that meaning hinges on a single, shared frame. This lens challenges pluralistic interpretations and invites reflection on how we compare normative arguments across cultures.
items.summary_zh: 哲学家阿格尼斯·卡拉德提出了“统一情境”观念，认为意义依赖于一个共同的框架。这一视角挑战了多元化解读，促使我们反思在跨文化讨论中如何比较规范性论点。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Agnost AI (YC S26) – Extract user feedback from agent conversations
items.title_zh: Agnost AI（YC S26）—从代理对话中提取用户反馈
items.summary_en: Agnost AI offers tooling to extract structured user feedback from agent conversations, helping product teams quickly identify issues and improve agent behavior, speeding iteration and alignment.
items.summary_zh: Agnost AI 提供从代理对话中提取结构化用户反馈的工具，帮助产品团队更高效地迭代并改进代理表现，提升迭代效率。它将对话中的反馈转化为可操作的改进点。

items.title_en: Satellite Tracker – Live Map of Starlink and 30k Satellites
items.title_zh: 卫星追踪器——星链与3万颗卫星的实时地图
items.summary_en: A live map visualizes Starlink satellites alongside tens of thousands of others, offering a real-time view of orbital density and coverage. The tool highlights how mega-constellations and space debris could affect satellite operations and traffic management.
items.summary_zh: 实时地图将星链卫星与数万颗卫星呈现在同一画面，提供轨道密度与覆盖范围的即时视图。该工具凸显大型星座与航天垃圾对卫星运营和轨道交通管理的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Your 'app' could have been a webpage (so I fixed it for you)
items.title_zh: 你的“应用”其实可以是网页版本——我把它改成网页了
items.summary_en: A practical take on web vs native apps: many projects can be delivered as a robust webpage, reducing maintenance and improving accessibility. The post shows concrete steps to flatten typical app functionality into a responsive web UI.
items.summary_zh: 谈及网页与原生应用的现实取舍：很多项目其实可以用强大的网页版本来实现，降低维护成本并提升可访问性。文中给出将常见应用功能转换成响应式网页界面的具体做法。

items.title_en: The Agentic Loop: Three loops in a trench coat
items.title_zh: 代理性循环：三个环路合体
items.summary_en: Introduces the Agentic Loop, a model with three interacting feedback loops governing how AI agents decide, act, and learn, highlighting safety and governance implications.
items.summary_zh: 提出代理性循环模型，描述决策、行动与学习三个互相作用的反馈环路及其安全与治理挑战。

items.title_en: Guardian Angels: LLM Personalization for Productivity and Security
items.title_zh: 守护天使：提升生产力与安全性的LLM个性化
items.summary_en: Personalized LLMs can boost productivity while embedding guardrails to protect privacy and security. The piece outlines approaches like on-device customization, user-controlled data sharing, and governance to balance convenience with risk.
items.summary_zh: 个性化的LLM能提升工作效率，同时嵌入守护机制以保护隐私与安全。文中提出本地化定制、用户可控的数据共享与治理等方法，在便利性与风险之间寻求平衡。

items.title_en: The Conservationist Who Turned 40 Terabytes of Public Data into a Video Game
items.title_zh: 把 40TB 公共数据做成视频游戏的环保主义者
items.summary_en: A conservationist transforms 40 terabytes of public data into an interactive video game to raise awareness about biodiversity or policy. The project blends data visualization, tooling, and storytelling to engage non-technical audiences.
items.summary_zh: 一位环保主义者将 40 TB 公共数据转化为互动电子游戏，旨在提升公众对生物多样性或相关政策的认识。该项目将数据可视化、工具与叙事结合，吸引非技术受众参与。

items.title_en: The Memory Heist
items.title_zh: 记忆盗窃
items.summary_en: The Memory Heist discusses how personal memories and data are collected, stored, and potentially misused in modern digital systems. It raises privacy and consent concerns and proposes safeguards.
items.summary_zh: 记忆数据的收集、存储与潜在滥用成为现代数字系统的议题，涉及隐私、同意与数据治理，提出相关保护思路。

items.title_en: Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE
items.title_zh: Show HN：Juggler——开源 GUI 编码代理，由 JUCE 创作者开发
items.summary_en: Juggler is an open-source GUI coding agent built by the JUCE creator, aimed at generating UI code and components automatically. It signals progress toward autonomous GUI tooling that can accelerate interface development.
items.summary_zh: Juggler 是由 JUCE 创作者开发的开源 GUI 编码代理，旨在自动生成界面代码与组件。它标志着向自动化 GUI 工具迈进的进展，可能加速界面开发。

items.title_en: The bread paradox: why convenience always wins, and why SaaS isn't doomed
items.title_zh: 面包悖论：便利为何总能取胜，以及 SaaS 并非注定失败
items.summary_en: People consistently choose the easiest, fastest path, which fuels the enduring appeal of convenient software and services. The piece argues that SaaS remains viable because frictionless onboarding, integration, and ongoing value creation outweigh concerns about consolidation, offering strong reasons for continued investment.
items.summary_zh: 人们总是优先选择最方便、上手最快的选项，这使得便利性成为驱动软件采用的核心力量。文章认为 SaaS 仍具生命力，因为无缝上手、良好集成和持续创造的价值，能持续让用户愿意投资。

items.title_en: A Trip to 90s Kansai: Exploring the XD FirstClass Network BBS
items.title_zh: 90年代关西之旅：探索 XD FirstClass BBS 网络
items.summary_en: A nostalgic account of the XD FirstClass BBS network in 1990s Kansai, exploring the communities and tech that shaped early online culture. The piece shows how dial-up days fostered collaboration before the web exploded.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 1990 年代关西地区的 XD FirstClass BBS 网络，介绍其社区、软件和在线文化，对比现代网络生态。

items.title_en: The kids with phones are alright
items.title_zh: 手机在手的孩子们其实并非问题
items.summary_en: A post contends that kids with smartphones fare fine, offering data-driven perspectives on screen time, education, and social development. It argues responsible design and parental guidance matter more than device presence.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为拥有手机的孩子们并非问题，结合数据观点探讨屏幕时间、教育与社交发展的关系。强调负责任的设计与家长引导比单纯禁用设备更为关键。

items.title_en: The largest available Minecraft world, totalling 15 TB
items.title_zh: 现有最大的 Minecraft 世界：总容量达 15 TB
items.summary_en: The largest available Minecraft world spans 15 TB, pushing storage, streaming, and mod ecosystems to their limits. Such massive worlds stress hosting infrastructure, data integrity, and distribution challenges.
items.summary_zh: 总容量达 15 TB 的最大 Minecraft 世界展示了玩家社区在像素世界规模化方面的极限，考验存储、流式传输和模组生态系统的能力，也带来托管、数据一致性与分发的挑战。

items.title_en: The Estranged Worlds of J. G. Ballard
items.title_zh: J. G. Ballard 的疏离世界
items.summary_en: An essay on J. G. Ballard explores his 'estranged worlds', examining dystopian landscapes and uncanny realism, and how his work foreshadows contemporary speculative fiction.
items.summary_zh: 评析文章聚焦 J. G. Ballard 的“疏离世界”，解读其对反乌托邦景观与陌生写实的描绘，以及对当代科幻文学的影响。

items.title_en: How the FSF sysadmins block botnets with reaction
items.title_zh: FSF 系统管理员如何用反应阻断僵尸网络
items.summary_en: FSF details reaction-based techniques to block botnets within the free-software ecosystem, combining monitoring, rapid response, and community-driven actions.
items.summary_zh: FSF 介绍了一套以“反应”为核心的阻断僵尸网络的方法，结合监控、快速响应与社区协作。

items.title_en: Latent Space as a New Medium
items.title_zh: 潜在空间成为新媒介
items.summary_en: Latent spaces in generative models are emerging as a new medium for creative exploration, enabling designers to sculpt ideas through interpolation.
items.summary_zh: 潜在空间作为新媒介，允许设计师通过插值在概念之间进行创造与表达。其对艺术、产品设计和人机协作意味着新的工作方式。

items.title_en: The zero-cost fallacy: open-source software in the agentic era
items.title_zh: 零成本谬误：代理时代的开源软件
items.summary_en: In an era of agentic AI, open-source software is no longer cost-free. Sustainable funding, governance, and security mechanisms are increasingly necessary as autonomous agents rely on open ecosystems. This implies a shift in how companies and communities sustain open-source projects.
items.summary_zh: 在代理时代，开源软件已不再是零成本。随着自治代理对开放生态的依赖增加，需要可持续的资金、治理和安全机制，并推动新的开源资助与治理模型。

items.title_en: C3 0.8.2 a Modest Improvement
items.title_zh: C3 0.8.2 小幅改进
items.summary_en: C3 0.8.2 is a modest improvement release. It likely includes bug fixes, performance tweaks, and small feature refinements aimed at stability and developer ergonomics.
items.summary_zh: C3 0.8.2 为小幅改进版本，包含错误修复、性能优化与小幅功能微调，聚焦稳定性与开发者体验。

items.title_en: Andon (manufacturing)
items.title_zh: 安灯系统（制造业）
items.summary_en: Andon is a signaling system used in manufacturing to alert supervisors of problems and halt production when quality or process issues arise. It enables frontline workers to trigger quick interventions, reducing downtime and waste; modern implementations integrate with digital dashboards and escalation workflows.
items.summary_zh: 安灯是一套在生产现场用来发出信号、通知问题并在必要时叫停生产的系统。它让一线员工能迅速干预，显著降低停机和浪费，现代实现往往与数字看板和升级流程相结合。

items.title_en: Today I Rescued 7,234 Old GIFs
items.title_zh: 今天我拯救了 7,234 个旧 GIF
items.summary_en: A personal or archival project rescuing thousands of GIFs, highlighting challenges of preserving vintage digital artifacts and the value of media preservation. The effort underscores the fragility and cultural value of early web media.
items.summary_zh: 记录了拯救上千个旧 GIF 的个人/项目，凸显在数字时代保存早期媒体的挑战与价值。该行动强调了数字遗产保护的脆弱性与重要性。

items.title_en: Bootstrapping GDC with DMD
items.title_zh: 用 DMD 为 GDC 启动提供方法
items.summary_en: Using DMD to bootstrap GDC.
items.summary_zh: 用 DMD 为 GDC 启动提供方法。

items.title_en: An unusual way for your DHCP server to run out of dynamic IPs
items.title_zh: DHCP 服务器用一种不寻常的方式耗尽动态 IP
items.summary_en: A blog explores an edge case where a DHCP server exhausts its dynamic IP pool in an unusual way (e.g., due to lease misconfiguration or pathological client behavior). The example underscores the importance of sane lease lifetimes, pool sizing, and monitoring to avoid network access issues.
items.summary_zh: 博客介绍一个罕见的 DHCP 池耗尽案例，可能由租期设置不当或异常客户端行为引发。该案例强调配置合理的租期、池容量和监控的必要性，以避免网络访问中断。

items.title_en: Unlocking the PSP's Dual Core Setup
items.title_zh: 解锁 PSP 的双核架构
items.summary_en: A guide on unlocking PSP’s dual-core setup, enabling homebrew and more flexible performance. It covers risks, requirements, and potential benefits for enthusiasts.
items.summary_zh: 讲解如何解锁 PSP 的双核设置，让玩家能够使用自制软件并获得更灵活的性能。内容涵盖风险、硬件需求与潜在好处。

items.title_en: The Second Life of Sanskrit
items.title_zh: 梵语的第二次生命
items.summary_en: Sanskrit is seeing renewed interest beyond academia, with modern curricula, digital resources, and translation work expanding its relevance.
items.summary_zh: 梵语在学术圈之外重新获得关注，教育课程、数字资源和翻译工作正扩展其现代意义。文章探讨在教育与科技领域重燃梵语热潮的努力，呈现一种更广义的语言复兴。

items.title_en: Neverclick: Desktop application for performing mouse actions with your keyboard
items.title_zh: Neverclick：用键盘执行鼠标操作的桌面应用
items.summary_en: Neverclick is a desktop tool that maps keyboard input to mouse actions, aiding accessibility and productivity for power users. It showcases how keyboard-driven navigation can complement traditional mice.
items.summary_zh: Neverclick 是一个桌面实用工具，通过键盘控制鼠标，方便无鼠标操作、提升无障碍使用与生产力。它适用于需要精准定位的场景，如编程和游戏娱乐。

items.title_en: What Every Python Developer Should Know About the CPython ABI
items.title_zh: 每位 Python 开发者应了解的 CPython ABI
items.summary_en: The CPython ABI article explains object layout and how C extensions interact, highlighting why ABI stability matters for wheels and binary packaging. It offers practical takeaways for developers building or distributing Python extensions.
items.summary_zh: 本文解释 CPython 的对象布局及 C 扩展模块的交互方式，强调 ABI 稳定性对打包与二进制分发的重要性，并给出实际建议。

items.title_en: C++20 Improved the For-Loop Syntax
items.title_zh: C++20 对 For 循环语法的改进
items.summary_en: C++20 added a range-for loop init feature, letting developers declare and initialize a variable in the loop header. The change reduces boilerplate and improves readability when combining iteration with fresh temporaries or intermediate expressions.
items.summary_zh: C++20 在范围 for 循环中加入了初始化表达式，允许在循环头部直接声明并初始化变量。此改动减少样板代码并提升在与临时值或中间表达式一起使用时的可读性。

items.title_en: Combinatorial Games in Lean
items.title_zh: Lean 中的组合博弈
items.summary_en: A project that formalizes combinatorial game theory in the Lean proof assistant, illustrating how to model games, prove properties, and explore strategic reasoning with machine-checked guarantees.
items.summary_zh: Lean 中的组合博弈在 Lean 公理化体系中形式化，实现博弈策略的机器可检验证明。

items.title_en: Show HN: Web App Uses RTL-SDR to Align HDTV Antenna
items.title_zh: Show HN：网页应用利用 RTL-SDR 对准 HDTV 天线
items.summary_en: A Show HN project uses an RTL-SDR dongle to measure signal strength and guide users to align HDTV antennas precisely. It showcases a practical, low-cost approach to RF measurement that runs in-browser or with lightweight tooling.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目利用 RTL-SDR 调谐器帮助对准 HDTV 天线，展示了低成本、可访问的无线电频段测量方法。

items.title_en: The Trade in Looted Antiquities Endures for One Reason: Demand
items.title_zh: 掠夺性文物交易之所以持续：唯一原因是需求
items.summary_en: The article argues that demand from collectors and investors sustains the market for looted antiquities despite legal and ethical concerns. It highlights provenance gaps, enforcement limitations, and the role of global art networks in perpetuating illicit trade.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出对收藏家和投资者的需求是掠夺性文物交易持续的核心原因，尽管法律与伦理层面存在压力。文中强调来源证据不足、执法困难，以及全球艺术市场网络在此交易中的作用。

items.title_en: Editing React components that never rendered
items.title_zh: 编辑从未渲染的 React 组件
items.summary_en: A discussion on editing React components that were never rendered. It covers techniques for retroactive fixes, pruning, and tooling to keep codebases maintainable when UI bugs or dead components linger.
items.summary_zh: 关于编辑从未渲染的 React 组件的讨论，涉及回溯性修复、代码裁剪以及工具链的使用，帮助保持代码库在 UI Bug 或无用组件存在时仍可维护。

items.title_en: Surprising lessons from my research scientist job search
items.title_zh: 我研究科学家求职经历中的意外教训
items.summary_en: The author shares unexpected takeaways from the science job market, including the value of communicating impact, prioritizing roles with practical relevance, and building a strong portfolio. The piece offers pragmatic tips on networking, applying to non-academic tracks, and aligning research with product or industry needs.
items.summary_zh: 作者分享研究科学家求职过程中的意外发现，强调明确表达研究影响、优先考虑具实际相关性的岗位，以及建立可展示成果的作品集。文中给出建立人脉、申请非学术路径以及让研究对接企业需求的实用建议。

items.title_en: Ambient Website Background Clouds
items.title_zh: 网站背景的环境云
items.summary_en: A small open-source library to render soft cloud-like backgrounds on websites, offering a lightweight, aesthetic ambient effect without heavy assets. It’s a handy way to add subtle depth to UI while remaining performant.
items.summary_zh: 一个开源库，用于在网站上渲染柔和的云状背景，提供轻量美观的环境效果，无需占用大量资源。让 UI 增添细腻层次，同时保持性能。
